rules: Country id place:<ISO alpha-2 lowercase>. Name is the ISO common name where ISO has one, else the ISO English short name; the ISO short name and official name are aliases. iso_alpha3 holds the ISO alpha-3.
Country governing_body is 'Government of <name>' (with 'the' for a few countries), derived from the name. It is a label, not a legal name.
US state and DC id place:us-<USPS lowercase>. DC is a Census state-equivalent, so kind state.
Territories (AS, GU, MP, PR, VI) are kind territory. U.S. Minor Outlying Islands (UM) has no row.

County id place:us-<USPS>-<5-digit county GEOID> from the Census 2020 county list (50 states, DC, Puerto Rico municipios). Census 2020 lists Connecticut's eight counties; the 2022 planning regions are not in this pack. Territory counties are not in this pack.

City (incorporated place) id place:us-<USPS>-<7-digit place GEOID>. Included when POPESTIMATE2024 is at least 50,000. Name from the Census 2025 Gazetteer, without its type word ('city', 'town', 'village'...). A consolidated city-government's '(balance)' row is the city itself, so it keeps its name.
City parent is its county when the Census 2020 place-by-county reference lists exactly one county for the place and that county is in the pack. Otherwise the parent is the state.
Aliases: AP state abbreviations, DC and territory names, ISO alternate country names, a few city short names (NYC, LA, SF), and 'St.' for 'Saint' city names. Curated by hand, not from a source.
find() matches names, aliases, USPS codes and ISO alpha-3 codes, ignoring case, accents and punctuation.
